agreements.title: Dogovori
agreements.review: Reviewed: normal text, 56 dp portraits; identity, task, logistics and accepted total have separate reading groups. Rating action remains visible. Gallery header is unchanged.

agreement-waiting.title: Dogovor: sledeci korak prvi
agreement-waiting.review: Reviewed: existing next-step/deadline precedes accepted terms and total; fixed confirmation action is visible. No confirmation pressed.

chat-media.title: Fotografija na cekanju
chat-media.review: Reviewed: pending-photo explanation and both existing recovery commands use the full width; local failed-message and composer remain available.

chat-media-keyboard.title: Fotografija uz otvorenu tastaturu
chat-media-keyboard.review: Reviewed with docked Gboard: person name and terms entry stay visible; photo state, both recovery commands, writing and send controls fit above keyboard. No command performed.
chat-media-keyboard.note: Docked Gboard after temporary stylus-handwriting disable; no message or media command performed.

chat-keyboard.title: Poruke i tastatura
chat-keyboard.review: Reviewed: focused input and person identity remain readable with docked Gboard. Opening keyboard moved visible history upward; latest-message anchoring remains R14-N01.
chat-keyboard.note: Local inert draft typed; nothing sent.

chat-keyboard-tail.title: Poslednje poruke uz tastaturu
chat-keyboard-tail.review: Reviewed after manual scroll: latest response and local outbox/retry are reachable above composer and docked keyboard. This is not automatic tail anchoring or delivery proof.
chat-keyboard-tail.note: Scrolled to the local outbox tail; no retry or send pressed.

chat-media-large.title: Oporavak fotografije: usko i veliki tekst
chat-media-large.review: Reviewed at 320 dp and font scale 2 with docked Gboard: full-width state, remove and reconcile/retry commands, input and send/attachment controls are reachable by scrolling. No command pressed.
chat-media-large.note: 320 dp/font 2/docked Gboard; both recovery commands reached by scrolling; no command pressed.

chat-media-large-status.title: Citljiv status fotografije na uskom ekranu
chat-media-large-status.review: Reviewed at 320 dp and font scale 2: photo title and pending explanation remain readable in full-width lines, rather than fragments inside a thumbnail.
chat-media-large-status.note: 320 dp/font 2/docked keyboard; Gboard font-change notice dismissed; scrolled within app.

profile.title: Profil
profile.review: Reviewed: moderate 24 dp identity heading, edit-name entry, work setup and two schedule shortcuts on open white groups. Extra Back control belongs to the gallery harness.

profile-lower.title: Profil: privatnost i izlaz
profile-lower.review: Reviewed after scroll: support, about, privacy, blocked people, export, legal and logout entries remain reachable. No account command pressed.
profile-lower.note: Scrolled lower groups; no logout or account command pressed.

privacy.title: Privatnost i podaci
privacy.review: Reviewed inert unavailable-policy state: public/private explanations and existing data entries remain readable; unavailable legal state is explicit. This does not accept legal readiness or erasure.

push-settings.title: Podesavanja obavestenja
push-settings.review: Reviewed inert connected fixture: category controls and disabled save remain visible in the white-group treatment. No push activation or delivery is inferred; explanatory copy is still relatively dense.
push-settings.note: Inert shared presentation; no notification setting or provider changed.

ai-thread.title: AI razgovor: citljivost
ai-thread.review: Reviewed shared inert AI conversation and growing draft: medium type remains legible. Existing fixture reply is not a fresh provider response; no microphone or paid call.
ai-thread.note: Existing inert AI response; provider and microphone not called.

discovery.title: Zadaci i mapa: stvarno citanje
discovery.review: Reviewed real read-only route: 8 displayed results, 4 without map points, cluster and lower preview, selected Tasks root. No GPS or business command. This does not accept geographic data or all camera cases.
discovery.note: 8 real results, 4 without map points. No GPS or business command.

discovery-search.title: Pretraga i uslovi
discovery-search.review: Reviewed real read-only search panel: input, place counts, collapsed date choices and Clear/Show 8 controls remain readable. No apply or GPS action; query correctness not inferred from displayed count.
discovery-search.note: Opened existing search panel only; did not apply, request GPS or submit a task.
